batches.brief: Snapshot-load the invoicing history surface from OW_BILLING into Delta under ow_tp.ow_tp_invoicing_history: customer_master, customer_master_hist, entity_attr_value, invoice_header, invoice_line (read-only principal, snapshot load, no federation). Keys per mapping_spec.json. Tolerances tol-20261027-v1 (family oracle, live). Write only to the declared write_targets. Local plugin patches required BEFORE recon (apply to your session's plugin cache copy of skills/data-reconciliation/harness/recon/adapters.py): (1) in _uc_schema_facts change "tp.grantee <> t.owner" to "tp.grantee <> t.table_owner" (UC exposes table_owner); (2) inside _databricks_connect use sql.connect(server_hostname=host, http_path=http_path, access_token=_databricks_bearer()) for oauth-m2m (the connector's oauth_client_* kwargs drive interactive U2M and hang headless). Recon invocations: pass --target-http-path /sql/1.0/warehouses/565cd2fd713738c4 (the FULL warehouse path, not the bare id — bare id fails OpenSession). Override the stale env DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH with /sql/1.0/warehouses/565cd2fd713738c4 for every recon and grants probe you run. The previous run's structural blocker on this batch was the Delta informational-PK/grant surface seen through a stale grants probe; with the table_owner patch + correct http path the probe should read cleanly. If a structural blocker still stands after a clean probe, report its exact objects verbatim in your structured output — do not widen mo-invoicing-w1-structural (it covers only the five packages, not billing_history).

Convert the OW_BILLING invoicing package layer (pkg_ow_util, pkg_plans, pkg_rating, pkg_invoicing, pkg_dunning + triggers trg_billing_audit_log_id/trg_subscriptions_hist/trg_sub_no_uncancel/trg_usage_events_check + jobs JOB_NIGHTLY_DUNNING/JOB_PURGE_AUDIT_LOG) to Lakebase project ow-tp-billing on new branch mig-invoicing-w1 (schema ow_tp_invoicing). Snapshot-load every read/written table (codes, plans, tenants, subscriptions, subscriptions_hist, usage_events, rating_periods, rating_results, invoices, invoice_lines, credit_notes, dunning_attempts, notifications, billing_audit_log) via the read-only principal. All writing routines are unproven cutover exceptions — the requester selected execute-posture=unproven-exceptions (no EXECUTE grant); flag each as unproven. Tolerances tol-20261027-v1. One PR to the run branch. Merge authority: the requester authorized decision mo-invoicing-w1-structural (committed .migration/authorizations.json, kind merge_override) forgiving blocker class `structural` on exactly this batch's five units — the legacy estate declares 4 triggers in DDL but never installs them (all_triggers empty), so converted target triggers surface as trigger_extra by class and cannot be fixed in converted code. If parity is PASS and the only blocker class is structural, report merge_authority {kind: "human_override", decision_id: "mo-invoicing-w1-structural"} in your structured output — the wave's merge_overrides entry covers it only when you claim that decision id.
